de: Polish President Karol Nawrocki left the country's Constitutional Court building, where he arrived at night because of the unrest.

de: Three children were poisoned by carbon monoxide in a fire in a private house in the Irkutsk region.

de: US President Donald Trump said he would consider appointing rapper Nicki Minaj as White House press secretary.

de: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation struck the workshops on the territory of the Proton industrial zone, where components for weapons and military equipment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine were produced.

de: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of laboratory-confirmed Ebola deaths has reached 5,026.

de: Two U.S. Marines have been accused of stealing cash from cash registers in a number of Japanese cities.

d: Первый вагон пассажирского поезда сошел с рельсов после столкновения с медведем. Пассажирам пришлось провести в поезде ночь с пятницы на субботу, поскольку машинист опасался, что медведь выжил после столкновения и может представлять угрозу.
te: In the Network appeared the first photos from the scene of the collision of the train with a bear
de: The first carriage of a passenger train derailed after colliding with a bear. Passengers had to spend the night on the train from Friday to Saturday as the driver feared the bear had survived the collision and could pose a threat.

t: Зеленский пожаловался на сроки поставки США ракет для ЗРК Patriot
d: Зеленский призвал Вашингтон пересмотреть сроки поставки ракет Киеву.
te: Zelensky complained about the timing of the delivery of US missiles for the Patriot missile system
de: Zelensky called on Washington to reconsider the timing of the delivery of missiles to Kiev.

de: Air defense forces shot down 433 Ukrainian aircraft-type drones overnight.

de: Ukrainian drones tried to attack Russian regions on the night of October 31. Air defense forces shot down 433 UAVs.

d: Вице-спикер польского сейма Марцин Горала обвинил Дональда Туска в атаке на Конституционный суд и раскритиковал действия правительства.

de: Polish Vice-Speaker Marcin Gorala accused Donald Tusk of attacking the Constitutional Court and criticised the government's actions.

d: Риск распространения нового штамма коронавируса PJ.2.1 в мире возрастает.

de: The risk of spreading a new strain of coronavirus PJ.2.1 in the world is increasing.

t: В Белгородской области при атаках ВСУ погиб мужчина, четверо пострадали

te: In the Belgorod region during the attacks of the AFU killed a man, four were injured
de: During the day, the APU attacked the Belgorod region 133 times, using artillery, multiple launch rocket systems and drones. As a result of the strikes, a man was killed, four people were injured.
